facts.fact: A person may be exposed to 4,000 to 10,000 ads per day across programmatic, social, and offline channels, according to a Forbes Agency Council article cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: On any given day, a person may be exposed to [4,000 to 10,000 ads](https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbesagencycouncil/2017/08/25/finding-brand-success-in-the-digital-world/) seen across programmatic channels, social, and offline channels.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's article identifies frequency as the first sign of ad fatigue, which occurs when a unique user has been exposed to the same ad multiple times.
facts.quote: The first tell-tale sign of ad fatigue is simple: Frequency. If a unique user has been exposed to the same ad multiple times

facts.fact: StackAdapt's article states that a dropping click-through rate may indicate ad fatigue, as CTR shows how engaging ads are.
facts.quote: Since CTR shows how engaging your ads are, a dropping CTR rate may indicate ad fatigue.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's article describes frequency caps as a programmatic feature that controls the number of times a unique user is exposed to an ad.
facts.quote: This is a programmatic feature that enables you to control the number of times a unique user is exposed to your ad.
